sentences.en: His fake moustache started to peel off on one side.
sentences.zh: 他的假胡子一边开始脱落了。

sentences.en: I always notice when fake dinosaurs are used in movies.
sentences.zh: 我总是能注意到电影里用的是假恐龙。

sentences.en: He faked his death and assumed a new identity.
sentences.zh: 他假装自己死了，并且假扮了一个新的身份。

senses.zh: 伪造, 篡改, 对…做手脚 - 仿造 -
